content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the selection procedure in detail or an application start date.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy
Alloy Design and Processing Science for Additive Manufacturing of Rare Earth Permanent Magnets (Project Code – R/AEP)
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (Government of India, R and D in Electronics Group, Electronics Systems Development and Application Division)
24 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Consolidated compensation up to Rs. 37,000 per month (depending on qualification and experience)
Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST
Not specified in the notice; the project is undertaken in the Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering of the institute

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints one essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post: (a) Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. (b) Selection through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc.

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through a process described in (a) or (b) below

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 37,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The assignment lasts 24 months or until the project terminates, whichever is earlier. The notice calls it a temporary assignment in a purely time-bound research project. It names no allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications through online mode, to be submitted by 24 November 2026. It does not give the website address or the steps of the online form. The application form asks for the fee transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.). The notice prints no documents list.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says the qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and that mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. It gives no interview date, mode or marking scheme.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Kharagpur JRF post?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship) and GATE, or through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this IIT Kharagpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Kharagpur JRF?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 37,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for the IIT Kharagpur JRF post?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT Kharagpur JRF post?
faq.answer: Applications are invited through online mode, and the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the IIT Kharagpur JRF assignment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 24 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The post is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project.

faq.question: Q9. Which project is the IIT Kharagpur JRF post in, and who funds it?
faq.answer: The post is in the project "Alloy Design and Processing Science for Additive Manufacturing of Rare Earth Permanent Magnets" (Project Code – R/AEP). It is sponsored by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India.

faq.question: Q10. Does having the minimum qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the prescribed qualifications are the minimum and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.
